d:
Jab man parvati ne zid pakar li ki unke var sirph bhagvan shankar hi honge aur ghor tapasya karne lagin, tab sabhi saptarishi milkar unhen samjhane pahunche aur unse yah jid tyagne ke lie aneko tark diye aur unhonne unse kaha.
Loving a man who lives like a sant means accepting that his heart was never yours to possess.
To baba’s wife, marriage wasn’t about holding him back but standing beside a soul devoted to something far greater. She manages the home and honoured the bond, fully aware that while they shared a marital life together baba’s spirit always belonged to the divine.
